title: Operations Manager, AMXL
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

About Amazon  
At Amazon, we have a unique culture built on pioneering into unknown and new frontiers. From selling books to creating the Kindle, from making films to launching faster delivery, Amazon reinvents normal. After selling the first book in 1995, we have grown at an incredible rate and now have become the universe’s most customer centric company. By hiring those that take risks and find fulfillment through making the impossible commonplace, Amazon cultivates innovation. Every employee at Amazon has the power to forge their own path and to have a true impact on the business, and we find that exhilarating.
  
Read more about us at amazon.com/about  
  
When we hire you at Amazon, we hire for the future. With unlimited career opportunities, Amazon invests in ensuring our teams are always challenged, constantly learning from each other, and creatively contributing to our next big idea. You will be surrounded by the best innovators of our time and we welcome you to make history with us.  
See why diversity is important to us at amazon.com/diversity  
  
Amazon Operations  
Operations is at the heart of Amazon business. We are known for our speed, accuracy and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. In these key roles, you’ll come in to help us exceed productivity goals and deliver against our customer promises. Our scale is expansive and our presence is growing - some of our centers across the United States and Canada are over 1 million square feet! Our goal is simple: to offer the world’s greatest selection of products and services with the world’s best customer experience.
  
Watch videos on our team members at youtube.com/AmazonFulfillment  
  
The Role
  
As an Operations Manager, you will have the opportunity to lead LM operations for multiple Amazon & Partner sites You will be responsible for leading, developing, and engaging a team of exceptional talent that makes innovation possible; one of your main focuses will be motivating, mentoring, and coaching your team to become the best leaders they can be. To achieve this, Operations Managers are creative problem solvers who are able to dream in immense scale, interpret big data, and deliver meaningful results that keenly drive productivity and efficiency. Some of the position’s key responsibilities include:  
  
Supporting all safety programs and compliance to ensure a safe work environment for all associates and managers  
Leading and developing a team of Team Leads (front-line supervisors) and additional hourly associates by embodying Amazon’s Leadership Principles  
Acting as the primary information source for the team, maintaining compliance and consistency, and taking corrective action when needed  
Mentoring, training, and developing teammates for career progression, performance improvement, and recognition purposes  
Creating, communicating, and maintaining quality control policies and standard work procedures to Area Managers and associates  
Proactively identifying and leading process improvement initiatives using Lean tools to delight customers  
Building and delivering productivity plans by reviewing work forecasts, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Operations Managers to balance labor  
Evaluating performance objectives and metrics to determine inbound or outbound productivity requirements to achieve customer time, accuracy, and quality expectations  
Partnering with other managers to share best practices across shifts and the network  
  
We are committed to developing a diverse workforce and we are even more committed to working with you to make that happen. Depending on the type of job, you will be required to engage in physical warehouse activities with or without reasonable accommodation. These activities include the following:
  
  
Frequent walking in the building and around area; facilities are over a quarter mile in length  
  
Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation  
  
What do we offer?  
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1 and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. We grant each employee ownership in the company, including Amazon stock awards and a matching 401(k) program. But, if you’re not in it for those perks, here is one more: we don’t wear suits and ties! Come as you are because jeans, t-shirts, sneakers and sometimes a neon safety vest will be your daily outfit. Jeff Bezos’s most recent letter to shareholders sums it all up pretty well.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. description:
**ABOUT AIR FREIGHT OPERATIONS**

The Air Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing the import and export of goods by air. Their primary objective is to create and maintain efficient processes, guaranteeing the seamless movement of goods by collaborating with Airline partners, Procurement and Capacity management, network offices, vendors, and customs brokers, ultimately contributing to profitability.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**

As the Manager of Air Freight Export/Import Operations, your role involves overseeing and improving operational activities related to Air Freight Export/Import. Your primary focus will be aligning with the business strategy, which includes developing and implementing strategic plans to optimize export/import operations. Additionally, you will be tasked with fostering a culture of operational excellence, optimizing resources, delivering an exceptional customer experience, and maximizing profitability—all while ensuring strict compliance with industry regulations.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure cost-effective, high-quality air export/import operations processes and drive volume growth.
* Plan and deploy human resources and capital in an optimized manner to manage business cycle peaks and lows.
* Implement CW1 Best Practices, utilizing tools such as search grid, edocs, task, Auto Rating, Auto Costing, and E-Booking.
* Procure and utilize optimal airline capacity through network offices.
* Encourage consolidations to focus on specific sectors.
* Taking charge of supervising the team members for all relevant operations, efficiency optimization, and upholding the standards outlined in the 'one file, one operator' methodology.

  

**Stakeholder Management**

* Manage customer relationships and address grievances.
* Take responsibility for overall billing quality and timeliness, driving Operational Hygiene to achieve maximum results in KPIs.
* Manage relationships with multiple carriers, vendors, customs brokers, Terminal Custodians, and network partners.
* Mentor and manage the Air Export Team to deliver service excellence and profitable growth.
* Efficiently manage claims, customer complaints, Inter-Company Issues, and customer disputes for a healthy P & L.
* Demonstrate a problem-solving approach and proactively design solutions for customers by engaging with stakeholders.

  

**Team Management**

* Develop IKOs/KPIs with team members and monitor individual performance.
* Check your Teams Station Metrics Widget, and ensure every file has an owner (1F1O).
* Manage the allocation of appropriate resources and the commitment of staff.
* Run Daily Performance Dialogs to drive a performance focus of managing shipments and managing customers.
* Foster a culture of quality, service excellence (for internal customers), flexibility, and cost consciousness.

  

**Product Management**

* Ensure high standards of quality across operations.
* Interface with the Customs Brokerage & Clearance team.
* Drive and implement new product launches.

  

**COMPETENCIES**

**Functional Competencies**

* Product Knowledge: Thorough knowledge on the entire operational flow, from booking to documentation and customs clearance, ensuring efficient and timely movements.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing operational needs and environments.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks.
* Leadership and Team Management: Directing teams towards goals and optimizing productivity by promoting accountability.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high-quality results and services.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues.
* Strategic Planning: Developing and implementing strategic plans to achieve organizational objectives.

**WHO CAN APPLY?**

**Must Have:**

* 8-10 years of experience in logistics or airline.
* Experience managing a team of at least 5 people.
* Bachelor’s degree is required.
* Lead teams for operational excellence and a high-performance culture.
* Effective written and verbal communication with teams, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Promptly address operational challenges and make data-driven decisions.

**Preferred:**

* Courses and certifications in business administration, operations management.
* EXIM/IATA certification.
* Familiarity with Trade Laws & Regulations.
* Knowledge of the Indian Export & Import Trade, Trade Lanes/Routes, Commodities, and Major Players.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Store Assistant Manager cum Kitchen Operations – Hospital Canteen

Department: Canteen / Food & Beverage Services | Applicable to: Hospital Canteen Operations

1. Job Details

Job Title

Store Assistant Manager cum Kitchen Operations

Department

Administration / Canteen Services

Reports To

Administration Manager / Facility Manager

Supervises

Kitchen staff, cooks, helpers, store assistants, and canteen service personnel, as assigned

Qualification

Diploma or degree in Hotel Management, Catering Technology, Food Production, Hospitality Management, or a relevant field

Experience

3–5 years of experience in kitchen operations, stores, catering, or institutional food services; hospital canteen experience preferred

Employment Type

Full-time2. Job Purpose

To manage the hospital canteen's day-to-day store activities and kitchen operations efficiently, ensuring uninterrupted availability of raw materials, proper inventory control, hygienic food preparation, quality service, cost control, and compliance with applicable food safety requirements.

The role combines store management, kitchen supervision, food safety, staff coordination, and operational reporting to provide safe, nutritious, hygienic, and timely food services to hospital employees, consultants, visitors, and other authorized customers.

3. Key Roles and ResponsibilitiesA. Store Management and Inventory Control

* Maintain accurate stock records for groceries, vegetables, fruits, dairy products, meat, cooking oil, spices, beverages, cleaning materials, and other canteen supplies.
* Monitor daily stock consumption, minimum stock levels, reorder levels, and expiry dates to prevent shortages and wastage.
* Prepare purchase requisitions based on consumption patterns, menu requirements, and approved budgets.
* Receive incoming materials and verify quantity, quality, weight, specifications, expiry dates, and delivery documents against purchase orders.
* Ensure proper storage, labelling, segregation, and stock rotation using FIFO (First In, First Out) and FEFO (First Expiry, First Out), as applicable.
* Maintain separate and appropriate storage arrangements for dry goods, refrigerated products, frozen items, chemicals, and cleaning materials.
* Conduct daily checks of critical or perishable stock and periodic physical stock verification.
* Investigate stock discrepancies, shortages, damages, pilferage, and unusual consumption, and report them to the reporting manager.
* Coordinate with approved vendors and the purchase department for timely deliveries, quality issues, returns, and replacements.
* Maintain records of goods received, goods issued, stock transfers, wastage, returns, and closing balances.

B. Kitchen Operations Management

* Supervise daily kitchen activities, including preparation, cooking, portioning, plating, packing, and distribution of food.
* Coordinate with cooks and kitchen staff to ensure meals are prepared according to the approved menu and required service timings.
* Estimate daily food requirements based on expected demand from hospital employees, consultants, patients' attendants, and visitors.
* Ensure timely preparation of breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, beverages, and special meal requirements, wherever applicable.
* Monitor food quality, taste, freshness, portion size, presentation, and consistency.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of raw and cooked food and prevent cross-contamination.
* Monitor food preparation practices, holding temperatures, refrigeration, reheating, and serving conditions in accordance with applicable food safety procedures.
* Ensure that kitchen equipment, cooking ranges, refrigerators, freezers, exhaust systems, utensils, and work surfaces are maintained in safe and hygienic condition.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance and report equipment breakdowns promptly.
* Monitor daily food wastage and implement corrective measures to improve yield, portion control, and cost efficiency.

C. Food Safety, Hygiene and Regulatory Compliance

* Ensure compliance with applicable Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) requirements, licence conditions, and hospital food safety policies.
* Enforce personal hygiene requirements, including clean uniforms, head coverings, hand hygiene, and appropriate protective equipment.
* Ensure routine cleaning and sanitization of kitchen areas, food-contact surfaces, storage areas, utensils, and equipment.
* Monitor pest-control measures, waste segregation, garbage disposal, and drainage cleanliness.
* Ensure safe potable water availability and appropriate food handling practices.
* Check the condition of incoming raw materials and reject or report spoiled, contaminated, damaged, or unsuitable supplies.
* Maintain food safety records, including temperature logs, cleaning checklists, stock inspection records, and other applicable monitoring documents.
* Support food safety inspections, internal audits, corrective actions, and regulatory inspections.
* Ensure staff understand procedures for reporting suspected food contamination, foodborne illness concerns, and kitchen accidents.
* Coordinate with the hospital's infection control, housekeeping, engineering, and administration teams on relevant hygiene and safety matters.

D. Staff Supervision and Coordination

* Allocate duties and responsibilities to kitchen, store, and service staff.
* Prepare or coordinate duty rosters in line with canteen operating hours and workload requirements.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality, grooming, discipline, productivity, and adherence to work instructions.
* Train employees on safe food handling, stock management, cleaning procedures, waste reduction, and equipment use.
* Identify staffing shortages and arrange replacements or escalation through the appropriate reporting channel.
* Coordinate with the HR department regarding staff attendance, training, competency, and performance-related matters.
* Promote teamwork, professional conduct, and responsive service to hospital staff and visitors.

E. Purchase Coordination and Cost Control

* Monitor daily and monthly expenditure on food materials, consumables, and kitchen supplies.
* Compare consumption against meal volumes, approved budgets, and standard recipes where available.
* Coordinate with the purchase and accounts departments regarding purchase orders, supplier invoices, delivery discrepancies, and payments.
* Monitor food cost per meal and identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary expenditure without compromising quality.
* Prevent over-purchasing, overproduction, avoidable spoilage, and unauthorized stock issues.
* Maintain records of vendor performance, material quality, price variations, and supply delays.
* Submit purchase requirements and stock reports within the prescribed timelines.
* Ensure that all purchases and stock issues follow the hospital's approved authorization procedures.

F. Hospital Canteen Service and Customer Satisfaction

* Ensure timely and uninterrupted canteen services during designated operating hours.
* Maintain cleanliness, orderly food display, and hygienic serving practices.
* Respond to complaints concerning food quality, portion size, availability, service delays, or cleanliness.
* Record complaints and coordinate corrective action with the appropriate staff or manager.
* Obtain feedback from hospital employees and other authorized users to improve service quality.
* Coordinate special catering requirements for hospital meetings, training programmes, events, and official gatherings.
* Ensure that special dietary requests are handled only in accordance with approved instructions and the hospital's applicable dietary procedures.

G. Documentation and Reporting

Maintain and submit the following records, as applicable:

* Daily opening and closing stock reports.
* Goods receipt and material issue registers.
* Purchase requisitions and vendor delivery records.
* Expiry, damage, wastage, and stock discrepancy reports.
* Daily meal production and consumption reports.
* Kitchen cleaning and sanitation checklists.
* Food storage and temperature monitoring logs.
* Staff attendance and duty rosters.
* Equipment maintenance and breakdown records.
* Food safety inspection and corrective action reports.
* Monthly inventory, food cost, and canteen performance reports.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The following indicators may be used for monthly performance evaluation. Targets should be finalized by management based on the canteen's size, meal volume, baseline performance, and approved policies.

KPI

Suggested performance measure

Stock accuracy

Physical stock compared with recorded stock

Stock availability

Frequency of avoidable stock-outs

Expiry and spoilage control

Value or quantity of expired and spoiled materials

Food wastage

Wastage as a percentage of food prepared or issued

Food cost control

Actual food cost versus approved budget

Timely meal service

Percentage of meals served within scheduled timings

Food safety compliance

Audit score and closure of corrective actions

Kitchen hygiene

Compliance with cleaning and sanitation checklists

Documentation

Completeness and timely submission of records

Customer satisfaction

Feedback ratings and complaint resolution

Staff management

Duty coverage, training completion, and adherence to procedures

Equipment maintenance

Completion of scheduled checks and timely reporting of breakdowns

5. Authority and Accountability

The position is authorized to:

* Monitor stock levels and initiate purchase requisitions within approved procedures.
* Allocate daily duties to assigned kitchen and store personnel.
* Inspect incoming materials and report or initiate rejection of non-conforming supplies in accordance with procurement policy.
* Recommend corrective actions for food quality, hygiene, stock discrepancies, and operational inefficiencies.
* Escalate equipment failures, food safety risks, staffing shortages, and budget deviations to the reporting manager.

The position is accountable for accurate inventory records, proper storage, kitchen coordination, food safety compliance, cost-conscious operations, staff supervision, and timely reporting. Financial approvals, vendor appointments, and major expenditure decisions remain subject to the hospital's delegation of authority.

6. Required Skills and Competencies

* Storekeeping and inventory management.
* Kitchen production planning and supervision.
* Knowledge of food hygiene and food safety practices.
* Understanding of FIFO and FEFO stock rotation.
* Basic costing, stock reconciliation, and budget monitoring.
* Vendor coordination and purchase documentation.
* Staff supervision, communication, and teamwork.
* Complaint handling and problem-solving.
* Computer literacy, including MS Excel and inventory or billing software.
* Attention to detail, integrity, discipline, and accountability.
* Ability to work in shifts, manage peak service periods, and respond to urgent operational requirements.

7. Working Conditions

* Work location: Hospital canteen, kitchen, and designated store areas.
* Working hours: As per hospital shift requirements, including weekends and holidays where applicable.
* The role involves standing for extended periods, inspecting storage and kitchen areas, handling operational records, and coordinating with multiple departments.
* Compliance with occupational safety, fire safety, food hygiene, and personal protective equipment requirements is mandatory.

8. Minimum Compliance Requirements

The employee must ensure that activities under their control comply with applicable FSSAI requirements, hospital policies, approved procurement procedures, occupational safety requirements, and relevant NABH standards where applicable to the hospital's food and support services.

The employee must immediately escalate any suspected food contamination, unsafe storage condition, major stock discrepancy, pest infestation, equipment safety concern, or other risk that could affect the health and safety of patients, staff, or visitors.
